opportunities.name: Mixed on-hit scissors
opportunities.objective: Test mixed on-hit scissors against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Skip 'n Slash adds 0.2 AP magic on-hit plus attack speed and range; four ordinary attacks prepare Snip Snip. Nashor and Rageblade emphasize repeated attacks while Blade adds physical current-health damage, making Terminus's mixed penetration relevant to attacks even though Q centers deal true damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Remain inside Hallowed Mist and build Q stacks before snipping.
opportunities.failure: No bulk or burst leaves Gwen vulnerable when Mist expires.
opportunities.test: Compare on-hit packets and Q center damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade is not assumed to multiply Q snips or grant extra Q stacks per phantom hit.

opportunities.name: Mist resistance drain
opportunities.objective: Test mist resistance drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: A Thousand Cuts heals from its champion damage, while Hallowed Mist grants 0.07 AP armor/MR; Riftmaker and Visage support repeated passive applications from Q centers and Needlework. Bloodletter assists magic passive/R packets, while Liandry supplies a burn during the extended duel.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit Q centers and stay protected from enemies outside Mist.
opportunities.failure: Enemies enter Mist or disengage before sustained effects mature.
opportunities.test: Record passive healing through a complete nine-needle R sequence.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic resistance reduction cannot amplify the true portion of centered Q.

ruledOut.reason: Rageblade is not assumed to multiply Q snips or grant extra Q stacks per phantom hit.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Mixed on-hit scissors
builds.summary: Test mixed on-hit scissors against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test mixed on-hit scissors against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Skip 'n Slash adds 0.2 AP magic on-hit plus attack speed and range; four ordinary attacks prepare Snip Snip. Nashor and Rageblade emphasize repeated attacks while Blade adds physical current-health damage, making Terminus's mixed penetration relevant to attacks even though Q centers deal true damage.
testPlan: Required state: Remain inside Hallowed Mist and build Q stacks before snipping.
Compare on-hit packets and Q center damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No bulk or burst leaves Gwen vulnerable when Mist expires.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade is not assumed to multiply Q snips or grant extra Q stacks per phantom hit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Blade of The Ruined King, Riftmaker, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts [6] seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for [10 / 14 / 18 / 22 / 26 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. 

The center of each strikes converts [50]% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals [80]% damage to minions.
Minions below [20]% health take [1000]% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.

Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for [4] seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain [(30 / 42.5 / 55 / 67.5 / 80) × (0.01)] Attack Speed, [15 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, [75] range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds [(0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 / 0.55 / 0.65) × 100]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals [30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage, Slows by [(-0.4 / -0.5 / -0.6) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds ([1]s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (3)] magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (5)] magic damage

Gwen's Attacks deal an additional [(1 + (0.006) × AP) × (0.01)] Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to [0.67] of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 40; raw flags preserved) + (0.07) × AP].
